caption: The drawing depicts a large, dark-colored funnel positioned diagonally from the bottom left to the upper right within a rectangular border centered on a beige background. The funnel is rendered in shades of gray and black, with stippling and shading to indicate its cylindrical stem narrowing smoothly to a wide conical opening. Two raised bands are visible around the wide part of the funnel. At the bottom left inside the rectangular border, there is an inset schematic of the funnel with dimensions labeled, showing a side view with a length of 7 1/2 units and a diameter of 5 1/2 units. There is a small, faint, irregular mark to the left of the funnel's wide end. The artist’s name, “CHARLES CARUJAN,” appears printed in the lower right corner outside the main rectangular border.
title: Funnel
